title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Tariff — Platform and Per-Disbursement Fees by Tier
content:
The fees an employer pays for the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service are set by the volume tier the service holds. The tariff below lists, for every tier, the flat platform fee, the monthly allowance of disbursements that carry no per-disbursement fee, the per-disbursement fee for each destination, the Earned Wage Access bundle discount figure and the business day on which monthly fees are debited.

## Schedule of figures

| Tier | Monthly platform fee (USD) | Included disbursements per month | Fee per payout to a Paystride Visa Payroll Card (USD) | Fee per external debit card payout beyond the allowance (USD) | Fee per same-day ACH payout beyond the allowance (USD) | Earned Wage Access bundle discount (percent) | Fee debit business day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 1.50 | 0.75 | 0 | 3 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 29.00 | 100 | 0.00 | 1.25 | 0.60 | 50 | 3 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 79.00 | 500 | 0.00 | 0.99 | 0.50 | 50 | 3 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 199.00 | 2500 | 0.00 | 0.75 | 0.40 | 25 | 3 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 499.00 | 10000 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.30 | 25 | 3 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 999.00 | 50000 | 0.00 | 0.35 | 0.25 | 25 | 3 |

## What each column means

- **Monthly platform fee** — flat monthly platform fee (USD per month).
- **Included disbursements per month** — disbursements per calendar month, in order, carrying no per-disbursement fee (count).
- **Fee per payout to a Paystride Visa Payroll Card** — fee per disbursement to a worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card (USD).
- **Fee per external debit card payout beyond the allowance** — fee per instant push-to-card disbursement to an external debit card beyond the included allowance (USD).
- **Fee per same-day ACH payout beyond the allowance** — fee per same-day ACH disbursement to a bank account beyond the included allowance (USD).
- **Earned Wage Access bundle discount** — discount on the platform fee for a month the employer's Earned Wage Access program was live on every day (number, percent).
- **Fee debit business day** — business day of the following month on which monthly fees are debited (ordinal); the figure 3 is the third business day.

## Reading the schedule

- The Starter tier carries no platform fee and no included allowance, so every external debit card or same-day ACH payout on that tier is beyond the allowance.
- A payout to a worker's Paystride Visa Payroll Card is priced at 0.00 on every tier.
- The bundle discount figure is 50 percent on Core and Growth, 25 percent on Pro, Scale and Enterprise, and 0 on Starter.
